feature.label: TEASED TODAY
feature.headline: Roblox Teases A Christmas Event
feature.dek: Santa has entered the chat. Roblox has not said when. The internet has opinions.
paras: Roblox posted a festive teaser on its official X account (watch it above), its strongest hint yet at a platform-wide Christmas event after The Hollow wrapped up Halloween. Roblox Japan's account had teased one earlier this month, and YouTubers spotted a test place on Roblox.
One leaker claims the event is called "The Festive" and starts December 17. Roblox hasn't confirmed any name or date, so treat that as a rumor until it's official. We'll update you the second it is.

stories.headline: Steal An Egg Makes $40M+ In Three Months
stories.dek: Turns out watching ads to hatch eggs faster is a business model.
paras: Roblox's biggest game of the year has brought in more than $40 million from in-game purchases and advertising over the past three months, Bloomberg reports. Players can watch ads to hatch their eggs faster, and that's exactly the kind of game Roblox wants for its growing ads business.
It's doing this while shrinking: the game averaged 1,341,295 players in October, down 26% on September. Still #1. Still printing money.

stories.headline: Roblox Beats On Money, Misses On Players
stories.dek: Wall Street wanted 145.8 million daily players. It got 138 million.
paras: In its third-quarter report, Roblox said revenue rose 16% to $1.572 billion and bookings came in at $1.7 billion, above what analysts expected. But daily active users fell 9% year over year to 138 million, short of the 145.8 million Wall Street was hoping for.
Investors cared more about the players than the money, and the stock dropped hard. That's why the chart above starts so low.

stories.headline: Analysts Lower Their Hopes
stories.dek: Three big banks trimmed their price targets. One raised it a little.
paras: After earnings, several banks changed their targets for the stock. Jefferies cut its target to $35 (from $38), JPMorgan to $46 (from $53) and Citi to $55 (from $60). Bank of America went the other way, nudging its target up to $48 from $45.
Investment firm ValueAct also sold out of Roblox in its third-quarter moves. In plain words: the grown-ups are nervous, the kids are still playing.

dealStories.headline: Tower Defense Simulator Teams Up With doBIG
dealStories.dek: A partnership, not a sale. The community still had feelings.
paras: Do Big Studios (doBIG), the company behind Blade Ball and many other hits, announced a partnership with Paradoxum Games, the studio that makes Tower Defense Simulator. TDS creator BelowNatural confirmed it is a partnership, not a full sale of the game. The price wasn't shared.

How much is TDS worth? **Our estimate: around $60 million.** Here's the math: in a 2026 lawsuit, a former co-developer asked for $25 million for what he says is a 40% share of the game. If 40% is worth $25M, the whole game would be about $60M. That's one side's claim in a lawsuit, so treat it as a rough guess.

up.headline: Throw Food For Animals Hits 2.47 Million
up.dek: From outside the top 50 to Roblox's #2 game in about a month.
paras: Throw Food For Animals by Goofy Chupacabra set a new all-time record of 2,474,602 players at the same time this week. Over the last 7 days it averaged 301,118 players, up 33% on the week before, and it has 333.6 million visits with 94% likes.
It wasn't in October's top 50 at all. The loop is simple: throw food, feed animals, collect, upgrade. The animals have not complained.

up.headline: Clean The Ballpit! Grows 33x In A Week
up.dek: A game about picking up plastic balls. A lot of them.
paras: Clean The Ballpit! (by TrixFarm, listed on Roblox as Mutrix Games) averaged 13,913 players over the last 7 days, up 3,237% on the week before. That means the week before it averaged only about 400 players. It hit an all-time high of 26,880 at once, and it only came out 18 days ago.

You collect balls, dump them for cash, and upgrade your tools, pets and storage to clean faster, solo or with friends. There's already a horror copy, Clean the ballpit [ANOMALY], where something called Bubbles hears you cleaning. Of course there is.

up.headline: Can You Land A Plane? Apparently Yes
up.dek: Up 3,142% in a week. Air traffic control is concerned.
paras: Can You Land A Plane? by Zzz Inc. averaged 6,143 players over the last 7 days, up 3,142%, with a high of 14,083 at once and 3.2 million visits.
Also climbing: ESCAPE CLUB (escape rooms) up 256%, and Drag Drive Simulator up 140% with a new record of 188,113 players at once after a limited update.

down.headline: Steal An Egg Is Still #1. Just With Fewer Eggs.
down.dek: Down 26% in a month, and still the biggest game on Roblox.
paras: Steal An Egg averaged 1,341,295 players in October, down 26% from September's 1,815,540. On Nov 20 it had 688,643 playing. Copycat Break and Steal an Egg grew 2,627% in October to 104,490, eating part of its lunch.
Don't cry for it though: it made $40M+ in three months (see Business & Markets).

down.headline: +1 Venom Evolution Loses Its Bite
down.dek: The +1 games keep replacing each other every few weeks.
paras: +1 Venom Evolution by Bottled Potential averaged 22,119 players this week, down 26%. It peaked at 102,184 at once and is 45 days old. Players still love it (97% likes), they just have a newer +1 game to play.
Also down in October: Animal Hospital (-50%), Blox Fruits (-45%) and +1 Speed Keyboard Escape (-45%).

stories.headline: Your UI Can Sparkle Now
stories.dek: 2D particles land in Studio Beta. Buttons everywhere are about to get very excited.
paras: Roblox Creators announced 2D particles for UI, now in Studio Beta. You can control their speed, drag and spread, then animate color, size and transparency over time.
Roblox pitches it for hit feedback, celebration bursts and ambient sparkle. In other words: every simulator's "+1" pop-up is about to get a lot shinier.

stories.headline: 80% Of Top Games Now Built With AI Help
stories.dek: Roblox says the robots are helping. The robots say nothing. Suspicious.
paras: Roblox says creators of over 80% of its top games now use its AI creation tools. In Studio you can now connect an AI agent, make changes, playtest, read the logs and repeat until the game works.
Roblox also plans to merge its Assistant and its new Build app, so you could start a game on your phone and finish it on desktop. Handmade studs remain available. For now.

stories.headline: Studio Now Animates From A Prompt
stories.dek: Type what you want, get an R15 animation. Animators: "fine, totally fine."
paras: A new Studio beta lets you generate R15 animations from a text prompt, plus an optional R6 motion rebuilder. It's part of a big wave of AI tools Roblox keeps adding to Studio.
The same week, the Asset Manager got a full release with folders and search, and the minimum draw distance went up to 500 studs, so even low-end phones see more of your map.
